title: QuadRenderer7Case - 0x466CE0 is the shared quad/texture renderer with 7 dispatch modes; char-create preview is one dynamic-mode caller among 11
objective: Close player-composition-evidence.json pending item 'preview path 0x466CE0/0x466F20 exact 7-case semantics (candidate: char-create preview only)' by mapping all 7 jump-table cases, all call sites, and the role of 0x466F20/0x467000 in the draw pipeline.
question: What do the 7 cases of 0x466CE0 (jump table 0x466EFC) draw, who calls them with which mode argument, and is 0x466CE0 really char-create-preview-only as the pending item speculated?
method: Full disassembly of 0x466CE0-0x466F08 (jump table entries read via struct from .data since capstone decodes the table as garbage), call-site enumeration with mode-argument extraction from push order, 0x466F20/0x467000/0x466FB0/0x466FE0 sibling-function decode, cross-referenced against the char-select tick 0x402BE0 and nameplate 0x40CE20 paths.

command_slots.v+0x94: (value, index, 0) textured-channel commands - (2,2),(4,1),(3,0),(5,2),(4,4),(6,0) style vertex/uv binds

The char-create preview is just the dynamic-mode caller 0x402B62 (mode passed from outside).

verdict: CLOSED - 0x466CE0 7-case dispatch fully mapped; shared quad/texture primitive with 11 call sites; char-create preview is one dynamic-mode caller
conclusions: 0x466CE0(surface, mode, rect) is the shared quad/texture primitive: prologue enables channels 0x1B/0x29 (v+0x50), then dispatches mode 0-6 via jump table 0x466EFC.

Modes 0-2 are single color quads (fill indices 6/2/4); mode 3 is the full textured quad (6 uv binds) with a clipped 3-bind fallback; modes 4-5 are 3-bind textured quads with different bind order; mode 6 is a re-enable + outline quad (fill 3).

11 call sites span char-select preview (0x402B62, dynamic mode), scene entities (0x40ABDF, state byte), nameplate (0x40D072, mode 2), window controls (0x436AEC/0x43864E, state byte), window backgrounds (0x44391A/0x445F37/0x4470E2, mode 2; 0x457530, mode 1), and generic surface draws (0x4544B2/0x457292, dynamic).

The player-composition pending item's '(candidate: char-create preview only)' is REFUTED: the char-create preview (0x402B62, inside 0x4029A0 draw member of screen 0x8A9520) is one caller among 11, and it uses a dynamic mode argument rather than a fixed one.

0x466F20 is the matching shadow-quad helper (same 6-bind structure as case 3 but with shadow params and channel teardown 0x1B/0x29=0); 0x467000 builds the 4x4 matrix consumed by the vtable+0x30 transform; 0x466FB0/0x466FE0 are vector dot helpers.
